name: Drummer
desc: Pop-art halftone drummer behind a full kit whose sticks plunge onto snare, toms and cymbals exactly on the beat, drum heads flashing and comic impact-stars bursting on every hit, tearing into a tom fill each phrase.

energy.doc: body bob / stick throw / glow amplitude

pose.doc: auto grooves and drops a fill each phrase; fill = constant tom roll; idle = light time-keeping

style.doc: aesthetic: ben-day comic ink / 2-ink misregistration / cyan schematic / wireframe skeleton kit / chiaroscuro

act.doc: multi-minute program: set = fill every 8 bars; solo_build = fills every 4 bars and a sustained roll on hot sections
